description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluththota, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410046
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals without wills. It involves land parcels, cadastral maps, property registration under the Registration of Title Act, and land settlement procedures - all falling under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
